start_vs_window: VIH before; MIH after (not applied to these areas)
details: Voluntary Inclusionary Housing: extra floor area for affordable units, in R10 and mapped Designated Areas (some 2005+ rezonings). Mandatory Inclusionary Housing (2016) applies only to areas rezoned after it; none of the 2003–2013 set. Fourth Ave 2003 had no bonus.

start_vs_window: bonus during; overlay late in window
details: Mixed-income housing bonus (voluntary) from Sept 2018: extra height/density for affordable units or Housing Trust Fund payment. Mixed Income Neighborhoods overlay (Bill 210633, passed 16 Dec 2021, in force about 6 months later): 20% of units in 10+ unit projects, at least 15% on site, renters ≤40% AMI, owners ≤60% AMI; only tracts in Council Districts 3 and 7. Overlap with reform stops not checked.

TOD regulating-plan density bonus (Plaza Saltillo, MLK, Lamar/Justin): at least 10% of bonus area affordable, owners ≤80% MFI, renters ≤60% (or 50%) MFI, or fee in lieu ($12–13 per bonus sq ft). 25% affordable is a goal, not a rule. Texas law bars mandatory set-asides.

BelRed FAR amenity incentive: first-tier bonus (up to 1.25 FAR in node districts) must be earned with affordable housing (rental ≤80% AMI, owner ≤100% AMI) or fee in lieu, before other bonuses. City says every BelRed multifamily project since 2009 used it.

TOD districts (adopted 15 Apr 2019): bonus height by points; affordable option = 10% of floor area above base height at 80% AMI or 5% at 60% AMI, or fee in lieu. Only about 8 affordable units by 2022. No mandatory rule found.

Affordable Requirements Ordinance: 10% of units (20% if city money) in 10+ unit projects that get a zoning change; TOD bonuses need a zoning change, and full bonus FAR needs the ARO units on site (half on site for partial bonus).

ARO 2021: 20% of units in 10+ unit projects with a zoning change, part on site in some area types (tiers not checked in final text). Connected Communities density bonus needs Council approval (so ARO applies) and on-site ARO units; parking-swap units add to the on-site count.

inclusionary_rule_in_window_code: voluntary-incentive tied to reform; mandatory-citywide from Jul 2022
start_vs_window: overlay during; EHA late in window
details: 38th & Blake incentive overlay (2018): height above base only with affordable units (residential must build, at 4x the linkage-fee requirement) or fees. Citywide linkage fee from 2017. Expanding Housing Affordability from 1 Jul 2022: 8–12% of units in 10+ unit projects, about 60% AMI rent / 80% AMI own.

inclusionary_rule_in_window_code: mandatory-citywide (for-sale only); higher tied to TOD bonus
details: Affordable Housing Requirement (Bill 58 of 2017, ROH ch. 29): for-sale projects of 10+ units, 5–20% islandwide (by affordability period), buyers ≤120% AMI; rentals exempt. TOD permits seeking bonus height/density: 10–35% for-sale or 15% rental at ≤80% AMI. Older 30% unilateral-agreement rule on zone changes not checked.

TOC tiers (5+ units): Tier 1 8% ELI or 11% VLI or 20% lower income, up to Tier 4 11% / 15% / 25%. Not mandatory: by-right projects need no affordable units. Also: Measure JJJ set-asides for 10+ unit projects needing a zone change (from Dec 2016); citywide linkage fee from 2018.
Inclusionary Housing: buildings of 20+ units, 20% at 80% MFI or 10% at 60% MFI (lower rates outside Central City to 2018), fee in lieu, tax exemption offsets.

inclusionary_rule_in_window_code: mandatory-citywide; reform itself incentive with affordability
details: Inclusionary rules: 10+ unit projects, 10% of units at ≤60% AMI rent (phase-in to Jun 2024), fee in lieu allowed. Complete Communities Housing Solutions bonus needs 40% of pre-bonus units affordable (15% at 50% AMI, 10% at 60%, 15% at 120%).

inclusionary_rule_in_window_code: voluntary-incentive tied to reform; mandatory-citywide from Apr 2019
start_vs_window: incentive during; MHA in last window year
details: Rezone added incentive zoning (SMC 23.58A): floor area above base only with affordable housing (or payment) and open space. Citywide Mandatory Housing Affordability passed 18 Mar 2019, in force April 2019.
Rezone made all added floor area contingent on public benefits incl. affordable housing under incentive zoning. MHA reached Othello only in April 2019.
No inclusionary or affordable-housing condition found in the TSA district rules or city code for this period. Later state HTRZ zones (2021+) carry set-asides but are outside the window.
No project-by-project requirement; affordable units only required when city money is used. Inclusionary zoning study began 2019, paused.
